    The category of primitive idempotent projectives #

    For a chosen complete family e i in a split-basic algebra A, the k-linear category of primitive left projectives has morphism spaces e j * A * e i from i to j. Taking one copy of every object in the additive envelope recovers A as the endomorphism algebra of that generator.

    This is the algebraic side of the standard mesh-presentation boundary. It is deliberately concrete: it is the full subcategory of the Karoubi envelope of the one-object category of A, written directly in terms of idempotent corners.
